svg.title: BlaBla architecture
svg.desc: project.bla composes behavior and structure contracts and registers project memory. Mission, System, Process and Knowledge are parsed by the memory subsystem and answered through status and explain; they never reach completion. Behavior contracts are parsed and type-checked into one typed contract IR that the behavior verifier runs as a coverage-guided campaign against the application through the trusted runtime, with counterexample shrinking. Structure contracts are parsed into a structure IR that the structure verifier evaluates against facts from a Python or Rust provider. Bounded task records under .blabla/tasks hold scope, deliverables and findings, and the skeptic forms one deterministic challenge from them. The behavior result is recorded with a run-state marker; structure is evaluated live. blabla status, explain, task, challenge and finish render these surfaces, and only finish decides the OVERALL gate.
